info.description:
Standalone multi-tenant document intelligence API. Reachable only via Caddy -> Kong -> Middleware V3 -> Document Intelligence. OCR runs in Codestra-OCR-Workers.

**OCR/QR output is an intake aid, not government authenticity verification.** Raw document images are never persisted; sensitive document numbers are stored only as a tenant-scoped keyed hash plus last four characters.
info.title: Codestra Document Intelligence API
